terms.quote: This ride will be starting at the Smiley's Shell station at the intersection of FM 980/247 on the North side of Huntsville. The route will be a ton of back roads all around Lovelady, up to Crockett for lunch, and then a meandering return to Huntsville. There WILL be some sand. You will not want to be on 50/50 tires, especially if you are on a big bike, unless you are Chris Birch... This is not really a good ride for people new to adventure riding unless they have a good history of riding dirt bikes before jumping into adventure riding.

publishability.permission_notes: Author posted the GPX for the Nov 15 2025 group ride; re-hosting in the library still needs the author's OK.

value_reason: A 212-mile East Texas DS/ADV loop with sand sections, run as a group ride. Good East Texas back-road coverage.
summary: About 212 miles of East Texas back roads around Lovelady up to Crockett for lunch and a meandering return to Huntsville. Starts at Smiley's Shell, FM 980/247 north of Huntsville. Author warns: 'There WILL be some sand. You will not want to be on 50/50 tires, especially if you are on a big bike.' Not for new ADV riders.
